Trade Operations Specialist with strong hands-on experience in Equity settlement under CSDR regime, specializing in managing settlement cycles, fails resolution, and trade investigations. Proven track record of minimizing client exposure to penalties through proactive issue resolution and analytical problem-solving. Known for delivering high-quality results within strict SLAs while mentoring new joiners and driving process understanding.
Prepared and analyzed daily and monthly CSDR penalty and reconciliation reports,
ensuring accuracy and transparency of settlement-related data.
Coordinated funding requests with Treasury to facilitate timely settlement of penalties
and cash obligations.
Executed trade amendments and Standing Settlement Instruction (SSI) updates to ensure
accurate trade processing and settlement.
Supported the end-to-end trade lifecycle, including trade updates, settlement activities,
reconciliation, and resolution of settlement-related exceptions.
Proactively identified risks and minimized client penalty exposure under the settlement
discipline regime.
Performed detailed root cause analysis of failed/pilfered trades, ensuring accurate
attribution of penalties to responsible counterparties.
Prepared and analyzed daily and monthly CSDR penalty and reconciliation reports,
ensuring data accuracy and transparency.
Initiated and coordinated funding requests with Treasury for penalty settlements and
cash obligations.
Managed daily analysis of CSDR penalty trades, proactively identifying risks and
minimizing client penalty exposure.
Executed trade amendments and static data updates (SSI changes) to ensure accurate
trade processing and settlement.
Supported onboarding and integration of new joiners through structured cross-training
sessions and process guidance.
Executed detailed UAT test scripts and contributed to achieving 100% test coverage prior
to production release.
Ensured timely settlement of Euroclear market cash equity, prime brokerage, and stock
loan trades as part of the fails management function.
Analyzed high-value and complex trades, initiating timely escalation of buy-in trades to
middle office and counterparties.
Executed pair-offs, netting requests, trade amendments, and cancellations, ensuring
accurate position alignment.
Processed manual trade instructions, internal/external transfers, and ensured proper
matching and settlement readiness.
Ensured accurate confirmation tagging and linkage of pending trades to maintain
settlement integrity.
Investigated and resolved cash and stock breaks, ensuring accurate reconciliation of
trading positions.
Liaised with Euroclear agents and global stakeholders to track and resolve settlement
issues in a timely manner.
Gained working knowledge of CSDR regulation and its impact on settlement discipline and
penalty management.
ASSOCIATE 05/2019 to 01/2021 State Street Syntel Services Private Limited, Airoli (Navi Mumbai), India
• Assisted with processing of equities, short-term instruments, and fixed income securities.
Supported the custody and accounting of trade transactions processed via SWIFT
instructions.
Handled manual processing of short-term trades and electronic trades, supported in

Developed strong email communication skills, ensuring clear and professional

Took proactive ownership of tasks, ensuring accountability and timely delivery of
